**Completing a Science Course Early with Texas Tech K-12 (Tuition-Paid Program)**

---

**Minimum Completion Time**
- The **shortest time to complete a course is 30 days** from the date of enrollment.
- You cannot finish a course in less than 30 days, regardless of how quickly you work.

**Assignment and Exam Grading**
- **Assignments:** Teachers have up to **two business days** to grade each assignment after it is submitted.
- **Final Exam:** The final exam will not be available until all assignments have been submitted and graded.
- **Final Grade Posting:** Allow up to **five business days** for the final course grade to be recorded after completing the final exam.

**Working at Your Own Pace**
- You may submit assignments as quickly as you complete them, but must factor in the grading turnaround time.
- There is **no restriction** on how quickly you can submit assignments, but you must wait for each to be graded before moving on to the next, if the course is set up sequentially.
- You have up to **six months** to complete the course, but can finish in as little as 30 days if you work consistently and plan ahead.

**Summary of Timeline**
- **Fastest possible completion:** 30 days (if you work daily and submit assignments promptly).
- **Grading:** 2 business days per assignment; 5 business days for final grade after the exam.
- **Plan ahead:** To graduate in December 2026, enroll early enough to allow for the 30-day minimum and grading time.

**Next Steps**
- Enroll in your science course as soon as you are ready.
- Work consistently, submit assignments promptly, and monitor grading progress.
- If you have a specific graduation deadline, communicate with your teacher and advisor to ensure all requirements are met on time.
